name: Testing the Vessel
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
This will be a test; both of the ritual I performed, and of your abilities. Take this vessel, adventurer. With it, you will have the power to shrink and capture a creature inside of it.

Travel to the Hinterlands and look for creatures known as Wildkin that were once pets of the night elf goddess Elune. The vicious, primitive, or savage owlbeasts are your targets, adventurer. Kill 10, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them before their spirits can escape.
narrative.objectives:
Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin. Kill 10, and use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Wildkin.

Bring 10 Wildkin Muiseks and the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.
narrative.offerRewardText: Upon a violent death, the muisek of a creature may escape and seek revenge. Shrinking the creatures, as you did, adventurer, prevents the muisek from escaping. Now we may use it as we please!
narrative.requestItemsText:
Were you able to capture the wildkin?

If you succeed, we will be ready to shrink and capture the muisek of creatures of Feralas.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 45 to 50, 29,325 XP in all.

quests.name: A Strange Request
quests.objectiveText: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

quests.name: Testing the Vessel
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin.

quests.name: Hippogryph Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

quests.name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons.

quests.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants.

quests.name: Weapons of Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
